reviews.title: Flawed time
reviews.text: The Asr prayer duration countdown always shows incorrect time avoiding the impermissible time of praying before Magrib. Besides the last time of Duhur shows incorrect time. Finally, the Ramadan calendar is flawed. One can argue, it is because of the different time zone. Then what’s the point of gps tracking and auto updating timezone by the app if it will still show the incorrect time. I missed the first laylatul qadar because of this. I am deleting this app.
